CHAPTER.VERS: O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
Awake, harp and lyre: I myself will awake early.
I will praise you, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto you among the nations.
For your mercy is great above the heavens: and your truth reaches unto the clouds.
Be you exalted, O God, above the heavens: and your glory above all the earth;
That your beloved may be delivered: save with your right hand, and answer me.
God has spoken in his holiness;
Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Will not you, O God, who has cast us off? and will not you, O God, go forth with our armies?
Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
